items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I know Nelson from way back.

ctx.x: You go around and you watch them here and it seems to me they must have drunk a lot more in past than they did.

No, they did. Oh yeah. That's all the old fellas, you see, like Thomas and Nelson. Oh, Nelson. Oh, Jesus. You heard about Nelson. I know Nelson from way back. But he doesn't drink now. He's drinking now.
Oh, he's got two. Yeah. You see that? You know Nelson. Oh yeah, I know Nelson.
